01 — To-Scale Blueprint

Proposed master suite, drawn to scale

Redrawn cleanly from the source dimensions at 1 ft = 22 px. This is a working reference for framing and fixture placement — verify all measurements against the original architectural drawing before cutting any material.

Proposed master suite — 21.0 ft × 23.8 ft envelope, 368 sq ft total

Reconciling the source drawing — the original sheet lists the suite envelope (21.0 × 23.8 ft) and the bedroom+closet area (368.0 sq ft) directly. The bathroom footprint (9.41 ft × 14.0 ft) is the mathematical remainder of the envelope minus that labeled area, cross-checked against the "14 ft" figure printed on the bathroom's right wall. This reconciles cleanly — use it as the working number, but confirm against the original CAD file before finalizing cabinet/vanity orders.

16 ft × 9.8 ft bedroom zone

Fits a king bed centered on the far wall with room to flank both sides for nightstands, plus circulation space at the foot of the bed — matches the blueprint above exactly.

04 — Bathroom Concept

9.41 ft × 14.0 ft bathroom

Dual sink vanity along the top wall, linen and water closet tucked left, freestanding tub and separate shower along the bottom — matches Shower #2 and the tub/shower split called out on the source plan.
